scope.description: Read-only review of the native artifact catalog, schemas, indexes, staging/freeze plan and query contract for lossless file-count, byte, transient-storage and query-I/O reduction.

assumptions: No scientific row may be omitted, merged or reclassified to reduce output.
Legacy per-site layout remains an on-demand export and cannot become production authority.

step_verify.step: Trace every queryable artifact to physical format, sort key, primary key, index and semantic digest.
step_verify.verify: Handoff reports catalog inconsistencies, missing indexes and exact query amplification risks.

step_verify.step: Rank lossless output reductions by safety and implementation readiness.
step_verify.verify: Each recommendation states affected bytes/files/transient copies, canonical-row invariant and validator check.
